runs.text:
If memory repaints, then accuracy is not fidelity to
the first day but loyalty to the later ones. We keep
what we have agreed to keep, and we call the result
ourselves. The witness who hesitates may be the only
honest one in the room.

None of this makes memory useless. A tool that changes
with the hand is still a tool, and the stories we
retell are the only ones that survive a family.
The rest is weather.

1. The image of the repainted room is borrowed from a
seminar note taken in the winter of 2019 and copied here
without correction, which is the point of the footnote.
